description: Estimated take-home pay from a monthly gross salary: worker BPJS deductions (JHT, JP, JKN), PPh 21 by the PP 58/2023 TER table or the December annual recalculation, and the employer's own contributions, each line with its decree. Give gross, or regency_code to use that kabupaten/kota UMK. An estimate; the employer payslip decides.

gross.description: Monthly gross salary in rupiah; omit when regency_code is given

jkk_band.description: JKK risk band of the employer; default sangat_rendah (the lowest band, 0,24%)

jkn.description: Whether BPJS Kesehatan applies, default true

jkn_employer_taxable.description: Count the employer JKN premium as taxable income, default true

jp.description: Whether Jaminan Pensiun applies, default true

jp_cap.description: JP wage cap in rupiah; default is the stored 2026 cap (Rp10.547.400), give it to use another

month.description: monthly (TER, January to November) or december (annual recalculation), default monthly

regency_code.description: Use this kabupaten/kota newest UMK as the gross, optional

name: calculate_net_salary
